design_philosophy.vibe: Dark cinematic industrial, precise, and mechanical.
design_philosophy.core_principle: Make the interface behave like sound itself: tempo, pacing, and visual rhythm should mirror a premium audio brand. Emphasize the matte black/charcoal palette with stark red highlights.
design_philosophy.spacing_strategy: Generous spacing. Use large gaps between sections to create a dramatic rhythm. Tight dense alignment for technical specs.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dark backgrounds to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #27272a on cards/sections. No soft shadows, use crisp industrial edges.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky navigation: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10

layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical layouts for feature sections. Ensure no 'Bootstrap-like' boring columns. Use col-span offsets to create tension.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line staggered text reveal using framer-motion.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero product image and marquee strip.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover zoom on product images (scale 1.05), red glow/pulse on WhatsApp floating button, crisp background color slides for primary buttons.

sections.name: Sticky Nav
sections.description: Glassmorphism dark nav. Logo top-left. Links center. Red CTA right.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Full-width dark industrial background. Large product image (10000 BW) with subtle parallax. Masked line-by-line reveal of 'Feel the Sound.'

sections.name: About / Manifesto
sections.description: Numbered manifesto chapters. Asymmetrical typography layout (e.g., Chapter 01 large on left, text aligned right).

sections.name: Editorial Marquee
sections.description: Slow, smooth, outline text moving horizontally. 'PROWAVE AMPLIFIERS — FEEL THE SOUND —'.

sections.name: Product Gallery
sections.description: Grid of amplifier images. Moody, spotlight backdrop. Hover state zooms image slightly and reveals an 'Enquire Now' red button.

sections.name: Why ProWave (Bento Grid)
sections.description: 4 feature blocks: Reliable Build Quality, Pan-India Network, Export Ready, After-Sales Support. Asymmetrical bento grid.

sections.name: Catalogue Download
sections.description: High-contrast section with charcoal background. Large red CTA 'Download Catalogue'.

sections.name: Location & Contact
sections.description: Embedded Google Map on one side, Contact Form (Name, Phone, Email, Message) on the other.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Minimal industrial footer. Logo, quick links, social icons, copyright. Charcoal background.

media.usage_instructions: Use product_10000BW for the hero section with parallax. Use all 4 product images in the Product Gallery grid. Map embed should point to Sector 7, Noida.

instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use pure Tailwind CSS for structural layouts and typography. DO NOT use Shadcn Card components for the marketing sections (use raw HTML divs to maintain the industrial/bento layout). Use Shadcn ONLY for the Contact Form inputs, textarea, and select.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid to all buttons, links, and form inputs (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use framer-motion for the masked line-by-line reveal in the hero and scroll-triggered reveals for the bento grid.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center on the root.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text or URLs. Use the provided brand assets.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment.
Ensure minimum WCAG AA contrast ratio for all text.
